content: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) devices are categorized based on their functionality as defined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA). Real-time CGM (rtCGM) systems continuously provide glucose data in real time, allowing users to monitor their glucose levels without any additional action. Intermittently Scanned CGM (isCGM) systems, on the other hand, require the user to manually scan the device in order to obtain glucose readings.
